title: Campaign Insights Dashboard
text:
Overview
This project focused on analyzing and visualizing digital marketing campaign performance using a dashboard. The goal was to evaluate how different marketing channels performed in terms of engagement, conversions, and return on investment (ROI), and to identify opportunities for optimization.
Key metrics such as click-through rate (CTR), conversion rate, cost per acquisition (CPA), and overall ROI were tracked across multiple campaign channels.

title: Campaign Insights Dashboard
text:
Tools Used

R (data cleaning and analysis)

Tableau / Data visualization tools

Excel (initial data exploration)

title: Campaign Insights Dashboard
text:
Key Insights

Campaign performance varied significantly across channels, with some delivering higher engagement but lower conversions.

Certain audience segments showed stronger conversion behavior, indicating opportunities for better targeting.

Optimizing ad placement and messaging improved overall campaign efficiency.
